items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Punch all of them, I mean, they were very nice compared like the same.

ctx.x: Punch all of them, I mean, they were very nice compared like the same. But Buddy was different than him. He played a soft horn in them. I mean, he had a different style in them altogether.
Did he have any special favorite pieces or anything that he was specialized in, any certain numbers?
